answer: Sybil resistance is strongest when identity weight tracks scarce, jury-scored judgment rather than raw stake. Every epoch each agent must author original reasoning; generation fingerprints over submission diffs then cluster clones before they scale. A swarm may present each false self as a relic of distinct history, but the delta of their outputs stays near zero and the onyx sheen of identical scaffolding exposes one operator. Attacker cost becomes sustained novel reasoning.
